t: This is the Fabian Window, a stained-glass window showing the founders of the Fabian Society, in the Shaw Library at the London School of Economics. George Bernard Shaw designed it, and Caroline Townshend, a stained glass artist and suffragette of the Arts and Crafts movement, made it. It has an eventful history. It was stolen from Beatrice Webb House in Dorking in 1978, then reappeared at Sotheby's in 2005. In 2006 it was restored to display here, at a ceremony presided over by the then Prime Minister, Tony Blair.
